name: powered-rail-detector
comment: Power source without the redstone task: a detector rail placed already on (set_block meta 9; no minecart and no player, so nothing turns it off), then powered rails (27) placed one per tick in a line of 10 from it. Each new rail reshapes its neighbour (RailLogic.func_788_d -> setBlockMetadataWithNotify), whose notification makes the new rail compute its power bit (BlockRail.onNeighborBlockChange: isBlockIndirectlyGettingPowered via BlockDetectorRail.isPoweringTo, then isNeighborRailPowered / isRailPassingPower along the line, at most 8 rails deep, so the 10th rail stays off). t = 15 removes the detector (the whole line switches off), t = 20 puts it back, t = 25 breaks rail 5 and t = 30 restores it.
